human.source: GSE58310 LPS-tolerised vs 6d RPMI macrophage control
human.test: paired t-test on donor-matched samples (the design is paired)

mouse.contrast: heterologous primed->LPS (n=4) vs media->LPS (n=2); the deposit has no LPS->LPS sample

overlap_test.test: one-sided Fisher exact, universe = genes measured in both and having an MGI ortholog

overlap_test_nominal_exploratory.label: EXPLORATORY: both gene sets are nominal p<0.01, NOT FDR-controlled; with 4 human donors and 2 mouse replicates the FDR-controlled sets are near-empty, so this test is reported as exploratory only

limitation: the mouse contrast is heterologous priming (CpG or poly(I:C) then LPS), not homologous LPS tolerance, because the deposited RNA-seq has no LPS->LPS sample; the human contrast is homologous LPS tolerance. The two are therefore not the same biological comparison.
